description: This file contains end-to-end test functions for team management commands in the Mattermost CLI, including creating, deleting, renaming, archiving, listing, restoring teams, and modifying team privacy settings.

classes.name: MmctlE2ETestSuite
classes.description: Test suite class for end-to-end testing of team commands in Mattermost CLI.

methods.name: TestRenameTeamCmdF
methods.description: Tests for renaming a team, including error handling, successful rename, and permission errors.

methods.name: TestDeleteTeamsCmdF
methods.description: Tests for deleting teams, including error cases, permission checks, and config-dependent deletion.

methods.name: TestModifyTeamsCmdF
methods.description: Tests for modifying team privacy settings, including permission checks and state changes.

methods.name: TestTeamCreateCmdF
methods.description: Tests for creating teams with various parameters, including missing fields, email assignment, and team types.

methods.name: TestSearchTeamCmdF
methods.description: Tests for searching teams by name, including existing, non-existing, and client-based searches.

methods.name: TestArchiveTeamsCmd
methods.description: Tests for archiving teams, including error handling, permission checks, and restoring teams.

methods.name: TestListTeamsCmdF
methods.description: Tests for listing teams, verifying active and archived teams visibility based on user permissions.

methods.name: TestRestoreTeamsCmd
methods.description: Tests for restoring teams, including success, non-existent teams, and permission restrictions.
